summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands on experience across the ML inference stack: custom CUDA kernel optimization, TensorRT and ONNX model deployment, and 8-bit quantization for efficient large language model inference. Built a three layer distributed system linking a mobile client, an edge server, and an embedded controller over a unified WebSocket pipeline, integrating real time model inference end to end. Comfortable moving between Python and C++ across the full pipeline, from model training and optimization through deployment on constrained hardware.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API, fine tuning DONUT for structured field extraction on a custom medical billing dataset.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch loading memory management for large scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy latency trade offs for deployment.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B for efficient large language model inference; profiled peak VRAM and latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase, a near lossless compression for edge deployment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice controlled, vision guided robotic pick and place system over a three layer distributed pipeline (Flutter, Flask-SocketIO, Jetson+Arduino) linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.
Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7 to 10.9 ms) for real time visual servoing; resolved 11 integration failures to reach 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory for weights and biases, eliminating per layer allocation overhead.
Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs. 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU TorchScript), a ~35% speedup over naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end to end ASR pipeline (mel spectrogram encoder, causal Transformer decoder with cross attention) trained on 1,000 Indian English samples.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython accelerated backend, a 4 to 5.5x speedup over pure Python.
